text: dsh-session-sidebar 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的会话侧边栏扩展，在工作区侧栏插入活动面板，并提供活动视图和置顶区。它汇总运行中、待处理及未读会话，显示最新回复摘要；支持工作区内或独立置顶、置顶排序、标记已读与未读，并允许 Agent 通过 activity_pins 工具执行会话管理操作。适合同时管理多个 DSH 会话的用户。它使用 DSH 的会话投影与存储服务，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-session-sidebar adds an activity view and pinned area to DSH Web and Desktop. It groups running, pending, and unread sessions with reply previews. Users can pin chats across workspaces, reorder pins, and mark sessions read or unread. Its activity_pins tool provides the same operations to agents.
想在一个地方查看哪些 DSH 会话还在运行。
有没有办法快速找出跑完但还没读的会话？
我想把常用会话固定在所有工作区上方。
让 Agent 帮我列出活动会话并标记已读。
Show me running and unread sessions across my workspaces.
I want to pin a chat above all workspace folders.
dsh-session-sidebar 的功能「会话活动视图」：在活动视图汇总运行中、未读和待处理会话，并按活动状态排序；列表项包含工作区和最近回复摘要。
dsh-session-sidebar 的功能「双模式置顶」：将会话置于独立置顶区或所属工作区，并可取消置顶；状态与 workspaceRegistry 同步。
dsh-session-sidebar 的功能「已读管理」：支持单条会话标记已读或未读，也可将会话列表全部标为已读。
dsh-session-sidebar 的功能「Agent 会话管理」：注册 activity_pins 工具，供 Agent 查询活动与置顶列表、调整置顶及已读偏好。
我想在工作区侧栏快速切换到未读会话。
Help me keep frequently used sessions pinned and ordered.

简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里同时开很多会话时，原生侧边栏只按工作区把列表铺开，哪个还在后台跑、哪个卡在审批等你处理、哪个已经跑完但还没看，往往得挨个点进去才知道。

`dsh-session-sidebar` 参考了 Codex 桌面端的侧边栏设计，同时支持 DSH Web 和 Desktop。它主要加了两样东西：集中看运行状态和未读消息的**活动视图**，以及排在工作区列表上方、方便跨项目整理常用会话的**独立置顶区**。

dsh-session-sidebar README · 预览：- **置顶与拖拽排序**：常用会话既可以留在原工作区里置顶，也可以拎到顶部的独立「置顶区」（自动附带 `📁 来源工作区` 徽章）；可在菜单中切换 `按会话选择` / `独立置顶区` / `工作区内置顶`，按住会话行上下拖动即可调整顺序。
- **活动视图与优先级聚合**：点侧栏顶部的铃铛（或按 `⌥⌘U` / `Ctrl+Alt+U`）切过去，正在跑（带转圈与并发计数）、等审批、以及刚跑完还没看的会话都会收在最上面的「优先级」里，看完可以一键全部标为已读。

dsh-session-sidebar README · 安装：Web 端和 Desktop 端的 profile 是分开的，用哪边就装哪边：

```sh
dsh-session-sidebar README · DSH Web：dsh plugin --profile web add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-session-sidebar

dsh-session-sidebar README · DSH Desktop：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-session-sidebar
```

装完后刷新页面（Web）或重启客户端（Desktop）就会直接接管侧边栏，不用额外改配置文件。

> **Desktop 提示**：刚装好的 DSH Desktop 需要先打开一次客户端让它生成默认 profile，完全退出后再运行 Desktop 自带的 `dsh` 命令。如果终端里找不到 `dsh`，可以在应用菜单的 **Manage dsh Command** 里开启，详见[官方说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime)。sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "link:/path/to/dsh-session-sidebar"
```

dsh-session-sidebar README · 活动视图：点侧栏顶部的铃铛按钮，或按 `⌥⌘U`（macOS）/ `Ctrl+Alt+U`（Windows、Linux）就能切换到活动视图；侧边栏收起成窄栏时点铃铛也会直接展开。后台有跑完还没看的会话时铃铛会亮蓝点，有会话卡住等你操作时亮黄点。

视图最上面的「优先级」区域会集中列出正在运行的会话（带子任务并发数）、卡在 `待审批` / `计划待审` / `待回答` 等你处理的会话，以及跑完还没点开过的未读会话（点开看一眼就会自动消掉未读）。点「优先级」右侧的 `...` 还能把已置顶或带定时任务的会话也放进来，或者开启「仅未读与运行中」、一键「全部标为已读」。

「优先级」下面按今天、昨天、星期几和具体日期排列各工作区的最近对话，每条都会带上所属工作区名称和两行最新回复预览。如果默认快捷键跟别的插件冲突，可以在 DSH 快捷键设置里搜「活动视图」改掉。

dsh-session-sidebar README · 会话置顶：原生侧边栏只能把会话固定在它所属的工作区里。装上插件后，点侧栏右上角的设置按钮可以在三种置顶展示方式之间切换：

- **按会话选择**（`hybrid`，默认）：每条会话的 `...` 菜单里同时有「置顶到置顶区」和「在工作区置顶」，两边随时能互移。跨项目常看的会话可以放到最上面，只跟单个仓库有关的留在原目录里。
- **独立置顶区**（`space`）：所有置顶统一收进工作区列表上方的「置顶区」，每条后面都会标出来自哪个工作区。
- **工作区内置顶**（`workspace`）：隐藏顶部置顶区，跟原生侧边栏一样只固定在各自工作区最上面。

在默认的「按会话选择」模式下，把会话放到顶部置顶区后，原工作区里默认还会保留它。不想两边重复看到的话，点「置顶区」右侧的 `...` 勾上「置顶后从原工作区隐藏」就行；同一个菜单里还能改悬停图钉的默认置顶位置，以及没有置顶时是否保留空的置顶区标题。

dsh-session-sidebar README · 分组、排序与搜索：常规侧边栏支持**按工作区**、**按工作区树**（根据目录路径自动把子目录缩进到父工作区下面）和**单列表**三种视图。在置顶区、工作区内部或单列表里，直接按住会话行上下拖动就能切到手动排序并记住顺序，随时也能在右上角设置里切回按最近更新排序。

顶部的搜索框除了即时过滤会话标题和工作区名，停顿一下还会全文搜索历史聊天内容（按 `Esc` 清空退出）。其余常用的会话与工作区操作（重命名、分叉会话、手动标为已读/未读、复制 Session ID、归档筛选、新建工作区时的目录选择弹窗）也都完整保留；归档正在运行的会话前会先弹窗确认停止。

dsh-session-sidebar README · Agent 工具（`activity_pins`）：插件同时给模型注册了一个 `activity_pins` 工具，和前端侧边栏读写同一份状态。不想手动翻列表时，可以在对话里直接让 Agent 处理，比如：

- 「帮我看看现在有哪些会话还在跑，或者跑完了我还没看的」
- 「把当前这个会话置顶到顶部置顶区，并且在原工作区里隐藏掉」
- 「把所有未读会话都标成已读」

支持的 `action` 参数：

dsh-session-sidebar README · Agent 工具（`activity_pins`）：| `action` | 说明 | 可选参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `list_activity` | 列出各工作区会话的运行状态、未读标记和最新回复摘要 | — |
| `list_pins` | 按当前顺序返回所有已置顶会话及其所在位置（`space` / `workspace`） | — |
| `status` | 查看当前的置顶模式、默认置顶目标、已读基线和活动视图设置 | — |
| `pin_space` / `pin_workspace` | 把指定会话置顶到顶部置顶区，或在所属工作区内置顶 | `session_id` |
| `unpin` | 取消置顶（同步更新原生的 `workspaceRegistry`） | `session_id` |
| `set_pin_mode` | 修改全局置顶模式与置顶区显示选项 | `pin_mode`, `default_pin_target`, `hide_space_pins_in_workspace`, `always_show_pin_space` |
| `mark_read` / `mark_unread` | 手动把某条会话标为已读或未读 | `session_id` |
| `mark_all_read` | 把当前所有未读会话全部标为已读 | — |
| `set_activity_prefs` | 修改活动视图筛选偏好 | `show_priority_section`, `include_pinned_in_priority`, `include_scheduled_in_priority`, `unread_only` |

dsh-session-sidebar README · 常见问题与卸载：**Web 里装好了，为什么打开 Desktop 还是原来的侧边栏？**

两边的 profile 相互独立，需要带 `--profile desktop` 再装一次（装之前记得先启动过一次 Desktop 客户端）。

**重启 DSH 之后置顶或已读状态丢了？**

状态默认存在 Host 的 `storageDomain`（`dsh-session-sidebar`）里，只有存储域打开失败时才会退回内存模式。请检查当前运行的 DSH profile 和安装插件时指定的是否一致。

**怎么停用或卸载？**

在对应 profile 的插件列表里移除 `dsh-session-sidebar`（或删掉配置中由 `cordis.patch.yml` 注入的插件条目），刷新或重启 DSH 就会恢复原生侧边栏。已保存的置顶和已读记录会留在存储域里，以后重新启用还能接着用。

dsh-session-sidebar README · 实现与本地开发：为了算未读状态去把所有历史会话全读一遍太重了，所以插件通过 `ctx.sessionProjections`（`dshSessionSidebar`）在回合推进时增量记录结束时间和清洗过 Markdown 的最新回复摘要。置顶位置、手动排序和已读时间戳保存在 Host 的 `storageDomain` 里，并与原生的 `workspaceRegistry` 置顶双向同步；前端的视图偏好存在浏览器 `localStorage` 中，目录展开状态则直接与原生侧栏共用 `dsh.workspace.view.v5`，切换置顶或已读时不会把已展开的文件夹收起。

目录结构：

dsh-session-sidebar README · 实现与本地开发：- `src/state.js`：不依赖 DOM 和网络的纯状态逻辑（投影折叠、未读判定、置顶 reducer）。
- `index.js`：Host 入口，注册会话投影、`storageDomain` 存储、`/dsh-session-sidebar/api` 接口和 `activity_pins` 工具。
- `client.js`：浏览器端界面，挂载 `sidebar.workspaces` 与 `shell.overlay` 插槽，使用 `--dsw-*` 主题变量适配亮暗色。
- `test/`：状态逻辑与客户端渲染单测。
- `docs/generate_demo_gifs.py`：生成 `docs/` 下中英文演示图的脚本（依赖 `pillow`，装有 `ffmpeg` 时体积更小）。

本地检查与单测：

```sh
npm run check
npm test
```

dsh-session-sidebar README · dsh-session-sidebar：When you have a dozen sessions open in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), the built-in sidebar only lists them by workspace. Figuring out which chat is still running, which one is stuck waiting for tool approval, and which one finished ten minutes ago usually means clicking through them one by one.

dsh-session-sidebar README · dsh-session-sidebar：`dsh-session-sidebar` brings a Codex-inspired sidebar to DSH Web and Desktop. It adds an **Activity View** that puts running, blocked, and unread chats in one place, plus a top-level **Pinned** list so you can pin cross-project chats above individual workspace folders.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Preview：- **Pinning & drag ordering**: Pin frequently used chats to the top-level **Pinned** list (tagged with the source workspace badge) or keep them pinned inside their own workspace; switch modes easily and drag rows to reorder.
- **Activity View & Priority triage**: Click the bell in the sidebar header (or press `⌥⌘U` / `Ctrl+Alt+U`) to see running (with live spinner and subagent count), awaiting-action, and unread chats under **Priority**, then mark everything read in one click when you're caught up.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Installation：DSH Web and DSH Desktop use separate profiles, so install the plugin for whichever environment you use:

```sh
dsh-session-sidebar README · DSH Web：dsh plugin --profile web add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-session-sidebar

dsh-session-sidebar README · DSH Desktop：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:QuentinCrane/dsh-session-sidebar
```

Refresh the page (Web) or restart the app (Desktop) and the new sidebar takes over right away. No extra config files needed.

dsh-session-sidebar README · DSH Desktop：> **Desktop note**: On a fresh DSH Desktop install, open the app once so it initializes its profile, quit it completely, and then run Desktop's bundled `dsh` CLI. If `dsh` isn't on your `PATH`, enable it from **Manage dsh Command** in the app menu (see the [Desktop docs](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime)).sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "link:/path/to/dsh-session-sidebar"
```

dsh-session-sidebar README · Activity View：Click the bell button in the sidebar header or press `⌥⌘U` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Alt+U` (Windows & Linux) to switch to Activity View. Clicking the bell while the sidebar is collapsed to the narrow rail expands it directly into the feed. A blue dot on the bell means a background turn finished since you last opened that chat; an amber dot means a session is waiting on you.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Activity View：At the top of the view, **Priority** collects chats that are currently running (with active subagent counts), blocked on `Approval needed` / `Plan review` / `Waiting for answer`, or unread since their last completed turn. Opening an unread chat clears its unread dot automatically. From the `...` menu next to `Priority`, you can also pull **Pinned** or **Scheduled tasks** into Priority, filter down to **Unread & running only**, or hit **Mark all as read**.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Activity View：Below Priority, recent chats across workspaces are grouped by Today, Yesterday, weekday, and date, each showing its workspace name and a two-line preview of the latest assistant reply. If the default shortcut collides with something else, search for `activity view` in DSH Shortcuts to rebind it.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Pinning：The built-in sidebar only pins sessions inside their own workspace. Click the view settings button in the top-right corner of the sidebar to choose between three pin display modes:

dsh-session-sidebar README · Pinning：- **Per session** (`hybrid`, default): Each chat's `...` menu offers both **Pin to Pinned list** and **Pin in workspace**, and lets you move between them anytime. Useful when you want cross-project threads at the very top while keeping repo-specific threads inside their folder.
- **Pinned list** (`space`): Puts all pinned chats into the standalone **Pinned** section above your workspaces, each labeled with its source workspace.
- **Inside workspace** (`workspace`): Hides the top-level Pinned section and pins chats at the top of their own workspace folder, just like the native sidebar.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Pinning：In `Per session` mode, pinning a chat to the top Pinned list still leaves it visible in its workspace by default. If you don't want to see it twice, open `...` on the **Pinned** header and turn on **Hide pinned sessions from their workspace**. That same menu also controls the default target for the hover quick-pin button and whether to keep the Pinned header visible when empty.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Grouping, Ordering & Search：The workspace view can group sessions by **Workspace**, **Workspace tree** (nests child folders under parent workspace paths automatically), or flatten everything into a **Single list**. Dragging a session row up or down inside the Pinned list, a workspace folder, or Single list view switches to manual ordering and remembers the arrangement; you can switch back to **Last updated** anytime from the top-right settings menu.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Grouping, Ordering & Search：The search bar filters titles and workspace names immediately, then runs a debounced full-text search across message history (`Esc` clears and closes it). Standard session and workspace actions (rename, fork, mark read/unread, copy Session ID, archive filter, and a built-in folder picker when adding workspaces) are all supported, with a stop confirmation if you archive a chat that is still running.

dsh-session-sidebar README · Agent Tool (`activity_pins`)：The plugin also registers an `activity_pins` tool backed by the same Host state as the sidebar UI, so you can ask the agent directly instead of clicking through menus:

- "Show me which chats are still running or have unread replies"
- "Pin this session to the top Pinned list and hide it from its workspace"
- "Mark all unread sessions as read"

Supported `action` values:

dsh-session-sidebar README · Agent Tool (`activity_pins`)：| `action` | Description | Optional parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `list_activity` | List running state, unread status, and latest reply snippet across workspaces | — |
| `list_pins` | List pinned sessions in order with their effective scope (`space` / `workspace`) | — |
| `status` | Read the current pin mode, quick-pin default, read baseline, and activity filters | — |
| `pin_space` / `pin_workspace` | Pin a session to the top-level Pinned list or inside its workspace | `session_id` |
| `unpin` | Unpin a session (kept in sync with `workspaceRegistry`) | `session_id` |
| `set_pin_mode` | Change global pin display mode and Pinned list options | `pin_mode`, `default_pin_target`, `hide_space_pins_in_workspace`, `always_show_pin_space` |
| `mark_read` / `mark_unread` | Manually mark a session as read or unread | `session_id` |
| `mark_all_read` | Mark all unread completed sessions as read | — |
| `set_activity_prefs` | Update Activity View filter settings | `show_priority_section`, `include_pinned_in_priority`, `include_scheduled_in_priority`, `unread_only` |

dsh-session-sidebar README · FAQ & Uninstall：**I installed it for Web, why does Desktop still show the default sidebar?**

Web and Desktop profiles are separate; run the install command again with `--profile desktop` (launch Desktop at least once beforehand so its profile exists).

**My pins or read states disappeared after restarting DSH.**

dsh-session-sidebar README · FAQ & Uninstall：Global pin scopes and read watermarks are stored in the Host `storageDomain` (`dsh-session-sidebar`), falling back to memory only if that domain fails to open. Check that DSH is running under the same profile you installed the plugin into.

**How do I disable or uninstall it?**

dsh-session-sidebar README · FAQ & Uninstall：Remove `dsh-session-sidebar` from the corresponding profile (or delete the entry added by `cordis.patch.yml`) and refresh or restart DSH to restore the built-in sidebar. Saved pins and read states remain in the Host storage domain if you re-enable the plugin later.

dsh-session-sidebar README · How It Works & Development：Reading full histories for cold sessions just to compute unread badges would be expensive, so the plugin registers a `ctx.sessionProjections` unit (`dshSessionSidebar`) that incrementally records turn-end timestamps and markdown-stripped reply previews as events arrive. Pin scopes, manual ordering, and read watermarks live in `ctx.storageDomain` and stay synced two-way with native `workspaceRegistry` pins. View preferences live in browser `localStorage`, and folder expansion shares `dsh.workspace.view.v5` with the native sidebar so pinning or reading a chat never collapses open folders.

dsh-session-sidebar README · How It Works & Development：- `src/state.js`: DOM-free state layer (projection fold, unread calculation, pin/read reducers).
- `index.js`: Host plugin entry registering the session projection, `storageDomain` store, `/dsh-session-sidebar/api` endpoint, and `activity_pins` tool.
- `client.js`: Browser bundle mounted on `sidebar.workspaces` and `shell.overlay`, styled with `--dsw-*` theme variables for light and dark themes.
- `test/`: Unit tests for state reducers, projections, and client rendering.
- `docs/generate_demo_gifs.py`: Script that generates the bilingual demo GIFs in `docs/` (requires `pillow`; uses `ffmpeg` if installed for smaller files).

dsh-session-sidebar README · How It Works & Development：Run syntax checks and tests:

```sh
npm run check
npm test
```
